reviews.name: Yasmin Stefanov-King
reviews.title: Flipping AWESOME (And yes, I know I am shouting!)
reviews.text: The speed of delivery is crazy fast! I thought it would be up to a week, but they came through within 48 hours. The shirts are great, and the joy is the fact they are coming from all over the world - which then means my youngest goes off to research that area. It has meant they now want to visit all the places the shirts are from, but hey, we can live with this! I have read reviews where people have said "I'm not paying that much for some team I don't know" - Really? Because these are still cheaper than the shirts for our local non-professional team, and we have a lot of those! If you are really narrow minded and ONLY want shirts for YOUR team, then no, this is not for you. BUT, if you love rugby, and want to see how it is done in the rest of the world, plus have an excuse to build your collection and knowledge of obscure and wonderful teams, then this is the thing for you. And let's be honest, who DOESN'T want a gift every month!?
